# Clean Data Engineering

> Everything is free (no sign-up, no paywall, no ads). A free, open community to learn data engineering, AI engineering, LLM engineering, ML engineering, software engineering and forward-deployed engineering together. Every role has a crawl (beginner), walk (intermediate) and run (advanced) path on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks and open source, with GitHub projects to build at each level. It also publishes open standards and research on building AI systems that hold up in production.

Key idea: learn the concept (the job) once; the cloud product that does it is a binding. Deterministic first: if ordinary code can do it, code does it; the model handles the rest.

## Learning paths

- [All paths, role by platform](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/): pick a role and a platform
- [Data Engineering](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/data-engineering/): You move, clean and shape data so other people can trust the numbers. Platforms: [AWS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/data-engineering/aws/), [Azure](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/data-engineering/azure/), [Google Cloud](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/data-engineering/gcp/), [Databricks](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/data-engineering/databricks/), [Open source](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/data-engineering/open/)
- [AI Engineering](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ai-engineering/): You build products and agents where a model does part of the work, safely. Platforms: [AWS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ai-engineering/aws/), [Azure](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ai-engineering/azure/), [Google Cloud](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ai-engineering/gcp/), [Databricks](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ai-engineering/databricks/), [Open source](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ai-engineering/open/)
- [LLM Engineering](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/llm-engineering/): You work on the models themselves: data, tuning, serving and cost per token. Platforms: [AWS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/llm-engineering/aws/), [Azure](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/llm-engineering/azure/), [Google Cloud](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/llm-engineering/gcp/), [Databricks](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/llm-engineering/databricks/), [Open source](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/llm-engineering/open/)
- [ML Engineering](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ml-engineering/): You turn models into reliable products: features, training, serving and monitoring. Platforms: [AWS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ml-engineering/aws/), [Azure](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ml-engineering/azure/), [Google Cloud](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ml-engineering/gcp/), [Databricks](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ml-engineering/databricks/), [Open source](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/ml-engineering/open/)
- [Software Engineering](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/software-engineering/): You build the services everything else runs on, and you make them dependable. Platforms: [AWS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/software-engineering/aws/), [Azure](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/software-engineering/azure/), [Google Cloud](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/software-engineering/gcp/), [Open source](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/software-engineering/open/)
- [Forward Deployed Engineering](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/forward-deployed/): You sit with a customer, find the real problem and ship a working system in their cloud. Platforms: [AWS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/forward-deployed/aws/), [Azure](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/forward-deployed/azure/), [Google Cloud](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/forward-deployed/gcp/), [Databricks](https://cleandataengineering.ai/paths/forward-deployed/databricks/)

## Courses

- [The AI Universe](https://cleandataengineering.ai/learn/ai-universe/): seven families of AI stacks, concept versus product, on open source, Azure, AWS and Google Cloud
- [Agent Harness, drawn simply](https://cleandataengineering.ai/learn/agent-harness/): one real agent end to end, 167 hand-drawn pages with real code
- [The Agent Harness Series](https://cleandataengineering.ai/learn/agent-harness/series/): the long version, 22 concerns, Azure architecture
- [Eval Harness, drawn simply](https://cleandataengineering.ai/learn/eval-harness/): checking what an agent did from its own traces, rules in YAML
- [Certification prep](https://cleandataengineering.ai/certifications/): free prep for Claude Certified Architect and Azure AI exams

## Community projects

- [All projects](https://cleandataengineering.ai/projects/): open projects with work packages, good first issues and roles

## Research and open standards

- [AI Assurance Catalog](https://dataagentsai.github.io/ai-assurance-catalog/): what must be true before an AI system is trusted
- [AI Harness Catalog](https://dataagentsai.github.io/ai-harness-catalog/): what must exist around the model call, 16 layers
- [AgentTwin](https://github.com/dataagentsai/agenttwin): simulate the agent's world to test a real agent
- [Reference Agent](https://github.com/dataagentsai/reference-agent): a customer-support agent with no framework, one module per harness layer
- [AgentTwin Lab](https://cleandataengineering.ai/lab/): research on long-running agents and autonomous fixers

## Optional

- [Writing](https://cleandataengineering.ai/writing/): notes from production ([RSS](https://cleandataengineering.ai/writing/feed.xml))
